info.name: Marketplace Nigeria API - Complete
info.description:
Complete API collection for Marketplace Nigeria with sample data

**Base URLs:**
- Local: http://127.0.0.1:8030
- Production: https://www.marketplace.ng

**Authentication:**
Most endpoints require Bearer token. Login first to get your token.

**All requests include sample data - ready to test!**

**Version:** 3.2
**Generated:** 2026-01-21 (Updated Routes)

request.description:
🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `POST /api/auth/apple`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\AccountController@appleLogin`

**Sign in with Apple — mobile SDK flow.**

The client app obtains an `identity_token` (JWT) from Apple's SDK and sends it here. Apple only provides `email` and `full_name` on the **very first sign-in** — pass them through on that call or they are lost permanently.

**Fields:**
- `identity_token` *(required)* — JWT from Apple's `ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential.identityToken`
- `full_name` *(first sign-in only)* — from `ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential.fullName`
- `email` *(first sign-in only)* — may be a relay address (`@privaterelay.appleid.com`)
- `device_name` *(optional)* — used to label the Sanctum token

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/adverts/{id}/related`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\AdvertController@related`

Returns paginated ads related to the given `ad_id`, ordered by relevance:
1. Same sub-category **and** similar title (highest priority)
2. Same sub-category only
3. Similar title only

**URL parameter:**
- `id`: The `ad_id` of the source advert (not the DB primary key)

**Query parameters:**
- `page` (optional, default 1)
- `per_page` (optional, default 20, max 40)

**Web equivalent:** `GET /related/{ad_id}`

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 10,
      "ad_id": 54321,
      "ad_title": "iPhone 14 Pro 256GB",
      "price": 500000,
      "contact_price": "no",
      "price_type": "Fixed",
      "state": "Lagos",
      "state_slug": "lagos",
      "title_slug": "iphone-14-pro-256gb",
      "category": 4,
      "sub_category": 6,
      "buy_direct": "No",
      "featured": "No",
      "sold": "No",
      "views": 120,
      "image_thumb": "https://marketplace.ng/...",
      "image_optimized": "https://marketplace.ng/..."
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total": 45,
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "has_more": true,
    "source_ad": {
      "ad_id": 12345,
      "ad_title": "iPhone 14 Pro",
      "category": 4,
      "sub_category": 6
    }
  }
}
```

**Query parameters:**

**Web equivalent:** `GET /seller/{name-slug}/{seller_id}`

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/categories/{category_slug}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\AdvertController@categoryAdverts`

Returns paginated ads for a category using `FeaturedAdPaginator`. Page 1 includes featured/boosted ads. Also returns the list of subcategories with ad counts and icons.

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "ads": [...],
    "cat": {...},
    "count_cat": 120,
    "subcategories": [
      {
        "id": 2,
        "sub_category": "Cars",
        "sub_cat_slug": "cars",
        "icon": "cars.png",
        "icon_url": "https://.../frontend/images/subcategory-icons/cars.png",
        "advert_count": 12500
      }
    ]
  },
  "pagination": {
    "has_more": true,
    "next_page": 2,
    "current_page": 1,
    "per_page": 24,
    "total": 120,
    "last_page": 5
  }
}
```

**Notes:**
- `subcategories[].icon_url` is `null` when no admin icon has been uploaded
- Subcategories are sorted by `advert_count` descending

📱 **Mobile Endpoint — Public**

Endpoint: `GET /api/categories/{category_slug}/subcategories`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\AdvertController@categorySubcategories`

Returns all subcategories under a category with live ad counts, an admin-uploaded icon, and a representative thumbnail image from the first active ad in each subcategory. Designed for the mobile category-browse screen (subcategory list view).

**Path params:**
- `category_slug` — e.g. `vehicles`, `phones-tablets`

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "category": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Vehicles",
    "slug": "vehicles",
    "total_ads": 45230
  },
  "subcategories": [
    {
      "id": 2,
      "name": "Cars",
      "slug": "cars",
      "advert_count": 12500,
      "icon_url": "https://.../frontend/images/subcategory-icons/cars.png",
      "thumbnail_url": "https://..."
    }
  ],
  "total": 8
}
```

**Icon priority (recommended display order):**
1. `icon_url` — admin-uploaded icon (PNG/WebP, shown at 60×60 px on mobile)
2. `thumbnail_url` — first active ad image for that subcategory
3. Fallback SVG placeholder in your app if both are `null`

**Notes:**
- Subcategories are sorted **alphabetically** by name
- `icon_url` is `null` when no admin icon has been uploaded for that subcategory
- `thumbnail_url` is `null` if no active ads exist in that subcategory
- `advert_count` only counts active, non-recently-sold ads
- No pagination — all subcategories returned in a single response

query.description: Page number (default: 1). Increment for load more.

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `POST /api/search`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\SearchController@search`

**Request Body:**
- `product` (string, optional, min 3 chars): Search term
- `location` (string, optional): State name (e.g. `Lagos`)
- `category` (integer, optional): Category ID
- `sub_category` (integer, optional): Sub-category ID
- `brand` (integer, optional): Brand ID
- `buydirect` (string, optional): `yes` or `no`
- `item_condition` (string, optional): See condition values below
- `per_page` (integer, optional, default 20)
- `page` (integer, optional, default 1)

**`item_condition` values:**
- General categories: `New`, `Foreign Used`, `Locally Used`
- Vehicles (category 1): `Local used`, `Foreign used`
- Phones & Tablets (category 4): `New - Unboxed`, `New - No Packaging`, `Used - Very Good`, `Used - Good`, `Used - Defect`, `Foreign Used - No Packaging`

> The correct table is chosen automatically based on `category`.

🌐 **Public Endpoint — Unified Filter (replaces all filter-by-* endpoints)**

Endpoint: `POST /api/search/filter`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\SearchController@filter`

All parameters are optional. Pass only the ones you need. Car/phone detail joins only activate when their specific params are present.

**General Parameters:**
- `keyword` (string, optional) — search term, matches ad title or ad_id
- `category` (integer, optional) — Category ID
- `sub_category` (integer, optional) — Sub-category ID
- `brand` (integer, optional) — Brand ID
- `location` (string, optional) — State name e.g. `Lagos`
- `per_page` (integer, optional, default 20)
- `page` (integer, optional, default 1)

**Price Parameters** (use `min`/`max` OR `range`, not both):
- `min` (integer, optional) — minimum price
- `max` (integer, optional) — maximum price
- `range` (string, optional) — `under_20k` \| `20k_120k` \| `120k_1m` \| `1m_10m` \| `above_10m`

**Listing Type Parameters:**
- `buydirect` (string, optional) — `Yes` or `No`
- `seller` (string, optional) — `all` \| `verified` \| `unverified`
- `item_condition` (string, optional) — general condition for non-car, non-phone categories: `New` \| `Foreign Used` \| `Locally Used`

**Vehicle-Specific Parameters** (category 1 — Vehicles):
- `car_condition` (string or array, optional) — `Local used` \| `Foreign used`
- `fuel_type` (string or array, optional) — `Petrol` \| `Diesel` \| `Electric` \| `Hybrid` \| `Natural gas CNG` \| `LPG`
- `transmission` (string or array, optional) — `Automatic` \| `Manual` \| `AMT` \| `CVT`
- `registration` (string or array, optional) — `Registered` \| `Unregistered`

**Phone-Specific Parameters** (category 4 — Mobile Phones & Tablets):
- `phone_condition` (string or array, optional) — `New - Unboxed` \| `New - No Packaging` \| `Used - Very Good` \| `Used - Good` \| `Used - Defect` \| `Foreign Used - No Packaging`
- `device_type` (string or array, optional) — `Smartphone` \| `Feature Phone` \| `Tablet`

**Response includes `filters_applied`** — echoes back only the filters that were active in the query.

> The old endpoints (`filter-by-seller`, `filter-by-buydirect`, `filter-by-car`, `filter-by-phone`) still work for backward compatibility but this single endpoint should be used for all new development.

⚠️ **DEPRECATED** — Use `POST /api/search/filter` with `seller` param instead.

Still functional for backward compatibility. Pass `seller: verified` or `seller: unverified` to the unified filter endpoint.

⚠️ **DEPRECATED** — Use `POST /api/search/filter` with `buydirect: "Yes"` instead.

Still functional for backward compatibility.

⚠️ **DEPRECATED** — Use `POST /api/search/filter` with `car_condition`, `fuel_type`, `transmission`, `registration` params instead.

Still functional for backward compatibility.

⚠️ **DEPRECATED** — Use `POST /api/search/filter` with `phone_condition` and `device_type` params instead.

Still functional for backward compatibility.

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/search/location/{location}/{slug}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\SearchController@locationSearch`

Resolves `slug` as a category, subcategory, or brand slug and returns paginated ads scoped to `{location}` (state name).

**Path Params:**
- `location` — state name (e.g. `Lagos`)
- `slug` — category_slug, sub_cat_slug, or brand_slug

**Query Params:**
- `page` (integer, default: 1)
- `per_page` (integer, default: 10)

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [...],
  "pagination": {
    "current_page": 1,
    "last_page": 4,
    "per_page": 10,
    "total": 38,
    "has_more": true
  }
}
```

query.description: Search term (ad title or ad ID)
Filter by buy direct: yes or no

**Query Params:**

- `product`, `category`, `sub_category`, `brand`, `location`, `buydirect` — optional filters

    "current_page": 2,
    "last_page": 5,
    "per_page": 10,

}
```**Request Body (GET query params):**\n- `product` (string, optional): Search keyword\n- `category` (integer, optional): Category ID\n- `sub_category` (integer, optional): Sub-category ID\n- `brand` (integer, optional): Brand ID\n- `location` (string, optional): State name\n- `buydirect` (string, optional): `yes` or `no`\n- `item_condition` (string, optional): See condition values below\n- `per_page` (integer, optional, default 20)\n- `page` (integer, required): Page number to load\n\n**`item_condition` values:**\n- General categories: `New`, `Foreign Used`, `Locally Used`\n- Vehicles (category 1): `Local used`, `Foreign used`\n- Phones & Tablets (category 4): `New - Unboxed`, `New - No Packaging`, `Used - Very Good`, `Used - Good`, `Used - Defect`, `Foreign Used - No Packaging`\n\n> The correct table is chosen automatically based on `category`.

Public Endpoint

Endpoint: GET /api/locations/states/{state}/lgas
Controller: App\Http\Controllers\Api\LocationController@getLGAsByState

Returns all Local Government Areas (LGAs) for a given state. The {state} parameter accepts either the state name (e.g. Lagos, FCT - Abuja) or the numeric state ID (e.g. 25 for Lagos, 15 for FCT).

LGAs are sorted alphabetically. Data sourced from the lgas DB table (774 LGAs across 37 states).

Error (state not found): 404 with { "success": false, "message": "State not found" }

Endpoint: `DELETE /api/user/delete-notification/{id}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@deleteNotification`

Deletes a single notification. Users can only delete their own notifications — attempting to delete another user's notification returns 404.

**URL parameter:**
- `id`: The notification's integer ID

**Success response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Notification deleted"
}
```

**Not found / wrong owner (404):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Notification not found"
}
```

🔒 **Requires Authentication (Buyer only)**

Endpoint: `POST /api/user/payments/{paymentId}/confirm-delivery`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@confirmDelivery`

Allows the **buyer** to confirm that they have received their order. Sets `buyer_status` to `delivered`.

**URL Parameter:**
- `paymentId` — The payment record `id` (integer)

**Authorization:**
- Returns `404` if the payment does not belong to the authenticated user, is not paid, or does not exist
- Returns `409` if delivery has already been confirmed

**No request body required.**

response.name: 404 — Order not found or not buyer's order

request.description:
🔒 **Requires Authentication (Seller only)**

Endpoint: `PATCH /api/user/payments/{paymentId}/shipping-status`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@updateShippingStatus`

Allows the **seller** to update the shipping status of a sold item. Only the seller who owns the ad can call this endpoint.

**URL Parameter:**
- `paymentId` — The payment record `id` (integer)

**Request Body:**
- `shipping_status` (required, string): one of `pending` | `shipped` | `delivered`

**Authorization:**
- Returns `404` if the payment does not exist, is not paid, or the authenticated user is not the ad owner
- Returns `422` if `shipping_status` is missing or not one of the allowed values

response.name: 404 — Order not found or not seller's order
422 — Invalid shipping_status value

request.description:
🔒 **Requires Authentication (Seller only)**

Endpoint: `GET /api/user/adverts/{advertId}/shipping-details`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@adShippingDetails`

Returns all seller-facing shipping details for a sold Buy Direct ad. Equivalent to the web page `/user/ad-shipping/{id}`.

**URL Parameter:**
- `advertId` — The advert's database `id` (integer)

**Authorization:**
- Returns `403` if the authenticated user is not the ad owner
- Returns `404` if no payment record exists for the ad

**Push Notification:**
This endpoint is referenced in the `ad_sold` push notification payload:
- `click_action: "OPEN_AD_SHIPPING"`
- `shipping_api_url: "/api/user/adverts/{advert_id}/shipping-details"`
- `shipping_web_url: "/user/ad-shipping/{advert_id}"`

**Response includes:**
- `payment_id` — Payment record ID
- `advert_id` — Advert database ID
- `ad_id` — Public-facing ad ID (e.g. 82174)
- `shipping_status` — `pending` | `shipped` | `delivered`
- `ship_code` — 10-digit code to present at shipping office
- `buyer` — name, phone
- `product` — name, thumbnail_url, ad_url
- `shipping_company` — name, logo URL
- `delivery_location` — address, city, state
- `instructions` — step_1 through step_4 (ready to display)
- `note` — Payment release notice

response.name: 200 — Success
404 — No payment record

request.description:
🔒 **Requires Authentication (Buyer only)**

Endpoint: `GET /api/user/payments/{paymentId}/details`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@orderDetails`

Returns full buyer-facing order details for a completed (paid) purchase. Equivalent to the web page `/user/order-details/{id}`.

**URL Parameter:**
- `paymentId` — The payment record `id` (integer)

**Authorization:**
- Returns `404` if the payment does not belong to the authenticated user, is not paid, or does not exist

**Response includes:**
- `order` — id, reference, amount_paid, payment_status, shipping_status, buyer_status, tracking_id, shipping_status_date, created_at
- `product` — name, price, state, thumbnail_url, ad_url
- `shipping_company` — name, logo URL
- `delivery_location` — address, city, state (GIG pickup location chosen at checkout)

response.name: 200 — Success
404 — Not found / not owner / not paid

Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@wishlist`

Returns the authenticated user's paginated wishlist with ad details, images, and category-specific details (car specs for vehicle ads, phone specs for phone/tablet ads).

**Query params:**
- `per_page` — items per page (default: 20)
- `page` — page number (default: 1)

**Response shape:**
```json
{

      "featured": 0,
      "ad_status": 1,
      "category": 3,
      "sub_category": 12,
      "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z",
      "image_thumb": "https://.../thumbnail.jpg",
      "image_large": "https://.../large.jpg",
      "car": {
        "brand_id": 5,
        "model": 22,
```

Endpoint: `POST /api/user/wishlist/{adId}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@addToWishlist`

Adds an advert to the authenticated user's wishlist. No request body required.

**URL parameter:**

item.name: 13. Category UI Config

request.description:
Get UI configuration for a specific subcategory.

**Authentication:** Not required

**Note:** Subcategory rules are ADDITIVE to category rules

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "show": ["divCar", "divModel"],
    "hide": ["divPhone"],
    "labels": {
      "brand": "Select Car Brand:"
    },
    "required": ["model"]
  }
}
```

**Mobile Implementation:**
1. Fetch category config first
2. Apply category show/hide rules
3. Fetch subcategory config when user selects subcategory
4. Apply subcategory rules ON TOP of category rules
5. Show subcategory-specific sections (divCar, divPhone, etc.)
6. Mark fields in `required` array as mandatory

Clear the UI config cache (admin use only).

**Authentication:** Not enforced but intended for admin use

**Use Case:** After updating UI config in admin panel, call this to force refresh

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "UI config cache cleared successfully"
}
```

item.name: 10. Advertising
item.description:
**Public Advertising Endpoints**

Fetch and display active advertisement banners and sidebars in the mobile app.

**No authentication required.**

**Ad Types:**
- `banner` – Full-width horizontal ads (top/bottom of screen)
- `sidebar` – Smaller ads (in-feed or side panel)

**Integration Notes:**
- Poll this endpoint at app launch and cache for session duration
- Open `url` in an in-app browser on tap
- Record clicks via the click endpoint for analytics

request.description:
🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/advertising?type=banner`

Fetch only banner-type advertisements.

**Use Case:** Display a rotating banner carousel at the top of the home screen.

**Response:**
```json
{

  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "advert_id": 12345,
      "company": "Acme Ltd",

      "url": "https://acme.com",
      "type": "banner",
      "expires_at": "2026-03-01 00:00:00",
      "days_remaining": 12
    }
  ],
  "total": 1
}
```

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/advertising?type=sidebar`

Fetch only sidebar-type advertisements.

**Use Case:** Display small promotional ads between listing cards in a feed.
